info.title: Nano Workforce control API
info.description: The externally-facing control surface an operator, an automation harness, or an LLM uses to observe and steer PR-convergence and planning runs. Contract-first (ADR 0058/0059): the toolkit derives typed request/response contracts + runtime validators from this document and each `operationId` is implemented by a delegate module in `operations/`. Mounted under base `/app/api`, kept off the framework-reserved `/app` page-runtime namespace (which owns `/app/runtime.js`, `/app/pages/*`, `/app/data/*`). The webhook endpoints are ordinary operations too (ADR 0059 — the `actions[]` array is retired): the shared-secret ones under `/hooks/*` and the capability-token side-channels (`/hooks/blackboard`, `/hooks/abandon`) all live at `/app/api/hooks/*` and enforce their credential in the delegate.

hookSecret.name: x-hook-secret
hookSecret.description: Optional shared secret. Enforced by the delegate (NOT the runtime) only when NANO_PR_WEBHOOK_SECRET is set; unset means the endpoint is open. Declared here for documentation.

blackboardToken.name: token
blackboardToken.description: Per-plan capability token for the blackboard side-channel (issues #51 / #49). The token IS the credential and scopes every read/write to exactly one plan. Enforced by the delegate (a missing token is 400, an unknown token 404); may also be sent as the `x-blackboard-token` header. Declared here for documentation.

abandonToken.name: token
abandonToken.description: Per-PR capability token for the cooperative abandon check (issue #76). The token IS the credential and scopes the read to exactly one PR. Enforced by the delegate (a missing token is 400, an unknown token 404); may also be sent as the `x-abandon-token` header. Declared here for documentation.

ActivePr.description: A tracked PR that is not in a terminal (converged/abandoned) state.

processKey.description: The engine process instance key; also the keyField the pages processExplorer link uses.

VersionInfo.description: The running app's identity (which code is actually live).

processKey.description: The started convergence-loop instance key (null if the engine did not return one).

alreadyRunning.description: True when a non-terminal convergence loop for this PR already exists; the aggregate was refreshed and no new instance was started.
True when a non-terminal plan for this issue already exists; no new instance was started.

StartVariables.description: The start request body. `pr`/`url` (convergence) or `issue`/`url` (planning) name the target; extra keys are forwarded to the engine as process variables.

pr.description: PR reference: owner/repo#123 or a PR URL.

issue.description: Issue reference: owner/repo#123 or an issue URL.

url.description: Alias for pr/issue when a bare URL is supplied.

MessageResult.description: The result of publishing a message / answering an escalation. Shape varies by message name; `ok` is always present.

FeatureAnswerRequest.description: Answer an implementation-phase task escalation (issue #25). Supply either `corrKey`, or both `plan` and `task`; `answer` is always required.

plan.description: Plan reference (owner/repo#N); combined with `task` to derive the corrKey.

task.description: Task id within the plan; combined with `plan` to derive the corrKey.

answer.description: The operator's answer that resumes the parked implementation agent.

cursor.description: The plan's current head id; pass it back as `since` on the next poll (Tier 2).

BlackboardAppendRequest.description: Append one blackboard entry. Idempotent on (plan, dedupe_key).

author_task.description: The authoring task id; defaults to "system" when omitted/blank.

kind.description: Entry kind (e.g. note, file-claim); normalized by the delegate.

files.description: Files this entry concerns (used by advisory file-claim conflict detection).

wave.description: Optional plan wave the entry belongs to.

dedupe_key.description: Idempotency key: a retry with the same (plan, dedupe_key) returns the existing entry.

inserted.description: False when a prior entry with the same dedupe_key already existed (idempotent retry).

conflicts.description: Prior sibling file-claims on the same file(s) (advisory first-writer-wins; never a lock).

abandoned.description: Derived from pull_requests.status; true ⇒ the run was cancelled and the agent must stop.

get.summary: List every tracked PR currently in flight (not converged/abandoned), newest-updated first.

401.description: Missing/invalid shared secret (only when NANO_PR_WEBHOOK_SECRET is set).

get.summary: The running app's identity (app/urban versions, git sha/branch, runtime, pid, uptime).

401.description: Missing/invalid shared secret (only when NANO_PR_WEBHOOK_SECRET is set).

post.summary: Register/refresh a PR aggregate (idempotent on prKey) and start its convergence loop.

400.description: The PR reference could not be parsed.

post.summary: Register/refresh a plan aggregate (idempotent on planKey) and start the planning fan-out.

202.description: The plan fan-out was started (or was already running).

400.description: The issue reference could not be parsed.

post.summary: Publish a message / answer an escalation. For escalation-answered and feature-escalation-answered names, runs the corresponding answer flow; otherwise a plain publishMessage.

name.description: The message name (correlates a waiting event).

200.description: The message was published (or the escalation answered).

404.description: No matching open escalation / parked token to answer.

post.summary: Answer an implementation-phase task escalation out of band (issue #25). Optional shared-secret guard (x-hook-secret), enforced only when NANO_PR_WEBHOOK_SECRET is set.

200.description: The escalation was answered and the parked agent resumed.

400.description: A required field was missing (answer, or a resolvable correlation key).

401.description: Missing/invalid shared secret (only when NANO_PR_WEBHOOK_SECRET is set).

404.description: No matching open task escalation for the correlation key.

get.summary: Read a plan's blackboard, scoped by the capability token (Tier 1). Optional ?since=<id> returns only newer entries.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The per-plan capability token (may also be sent as the x-blackboard-token header).

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Return only entries with id > since (incremental poll).

200.description: The blackboard page for this plan.

404.description: Unknown blackboard token (never reveals which plans exist).

post.summary: Append one entry to a plan's blackboard, scoped by the capability token (Tier 1). Idempotent on (plan, dedupe_key).

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The per-plan capability token (may also be sent as the x-blackboard-token header).

200.description: An idempotent retry: the entry already existed (inserted=false).

400.description: Missing blackboard token or blank body.

404.description: Unknown blackboard token (never reveals which plans exist).

get.summary: Cooperative abandon check (issue #76): tell a running agent whether its run was cancelled. Scoped by the per-PR capability token.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The per-PR capability token (may also be sent as the x-abandon-token header).

404.description: Unknown abandon token (never reveals which PRs exist).
